page.layout: One printed page, rotated on the scan so the lines run horizontally. One block of running text filling the page from the top to about two-thirds down; below it a shorter block of about eight lines. No marginal notes, running head, page number or catchword can be made out.

The paragraph divisions and line counts are estimates from the layout of the grey text blocks, not from readable print. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
